development.purpose: grammar-v2 construction and human linguistic review

blinding.licensing_effect: None of the exposed examples was used to add or revise a grammar-v2 license.

grammar_freeze.rule: No held-out token or annotation may add or revise a grammar-v2 license during this evaluation.

reported_historical_result.note: Historical result recorded for reproducibility; it must not be used to redefine the frozen split.

governance: The split is frozen independently of subsequent results.
Unlicensed predicates are outside lexical coverage, not generation errors.
Adjudication may classify held-out cases but may not modify the grammar under evaluation.
Any future re-evaluation with a changed corpus, grammar, annotation, or source mapping requires a new manifest version.
The 54/62 figure is compatibility among adjudicable covered predicate tokens, not general accuracy.
